tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang thun mong ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo badzra pā ṇa ye/dpal ldan rdo rje rab
(shrī)༄༅/dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang thun mong ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo badzra pā ṇa ye/dpal ldan rdo rje rab

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅ /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang thun mong ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo badzra pā ṇa ye/ dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis shes par bya ste/ dang po ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du/ sha khrag la sogs pa'i gtor ma ci 'byor pa bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ru ru las mi mgo kha phyir bstan gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba cig bsams la/ de'i dbus su oṃ/ shar du hūm̐/ lhor swa/ nub tu ā/ byang du hā/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ e las me 'bar bas thod pa gdung*/ yig 'bru lnga las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum gyi bdud rtsi ma lus pa bkug yig 'bru lnga la thim/ yig 'bru lnga po yang zhu zhing gcig tu 'dres pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba'i rang bzhin zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma'i mdun du kam̐ kam̐ las rdo rje rab brtan ma sku mdog smug nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku la mi pags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ dre'u gwa pa la chibs pa cig tu wal gyis bskyed la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rag mo du ra dun ting bhyoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par dbyer med du gyur par bsams zhing bzlas pa byed na/ srog snying 'di bzla'o// tadya thā/ oṃ ru ru bi tiṣṭha/ ba dho si/ ma ma rag mo/ tsitta kha rag mo bhyoḥbhyoḥswā hā/ zhes so// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ba ling ta kha raṃ khā hi/

yo gi nī kha raṃ khā hi/ ḍā ki nī kha raṃ khā hi/ staṃ ba wa kā tā kha raṃ khā hi/ a ka pā la ho kha raṃ khā hi/ a kā ro gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ a mṛ tas mchod la/ bstod bskul 'di bya'o// hūm̐ bhyoḥ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma// sku mdog smug nag chen mo la// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma// sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol// phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon pa'i phyag gis ne'u le 'dzin// chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs// phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe// mtshan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing byon// nyin gsum khra ltar 'khyug cing byon// bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab// ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma// dgra bo 'dul ba'i dus la bab// dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma// rakta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bstan ma'i gtso mo rab brtan ma// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bstan pa gnyan po khyod kyis srungs// zhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol lo// gsum pa ni/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs dang*/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par bsam/ rten yod na gshegs mi dgos brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo'o// gtor ma dpal 'bar dang bcas te sa gtsang sar btang*/ dam tshig ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ smra ba nyung zhing mchod gtor dang bzlas brjod la brtson pa des bsgrubs na zhag nyer gcig la 'grub ste/ ma dang sring mo'i tshul du 'ongs nas gong bsgo ba nyan gsung ngo*// bstan srung chen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i// sgrub thabs gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa 'di// chung ngu'i dus nas rdo rje rab brtan mas// legs par bsrung zhing stong grogs legs byed pa'i// shākya'i dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal gyis// dben gnas chen po zhwa lu ri phug tu// legs par sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams// phyi nang bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi nas// dam chos tshul bzhin legs par grub gyur te// bdag nyid chen mos legs par skyong gyur cig

/chos skyong ma 'di nyid u rgyan gyi yul du rdo rje sna yon mar mtshan gsol/ mi sha gsol zhing mi khrag gsol/ de nas tho ling gi srung mar byon/ rdo rje dbang grub mar mtshan gsol/ de nas dkar chung srung mar byon/ rdo rje gshog rgod mar mtshan gsol/ de nas dpal rgyan gong gi srung mar byon/ rdo rje rab brtan mar mtshan gsol/ 'di la rgyud che ba gnyis yod cing*/ sgrub thabs dang bstod pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa'i nang nas/ 'di zhi ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i thabs yin no// mkhan po lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yig cha la brten nas byas pa yin no// dge legs 'phel// ༈ /dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes su gnang ba bya bar 'dod pas/ mchod gtor bsnyen pa sogs gong du grub rjes/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas bsgrub par bya ba ni/ dang po gtor ma maṇḍal khrus gsol sngon du 'gro bas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// ma lus rjes gnang sku drin stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyud dag par byed pa'i ched du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba bzhugs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi sdig pa bshags pa'i sgo nas yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dngos gzhi bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med la mos gus 'dun pa drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas/ bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du/ dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

zhes lan gsum gyi bar du bya/ de nas bla ma phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma phyag rdor du bskyed/ bla ma yang gsang ba'i bdag por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i mdun du lha mo gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo// thugs ka'i bhyoḥmathing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings a su ra'i brag phug sogs nas spyan drangs nas de nyid du bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs byin gyis brlab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ khyad par du dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa byung*/ lha mo'i thugs kar phog lha mo'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas/ sngags lan gsum bzlas pas dang po dam tshig pa/ gnyis pas ye shes pa/ gsum pas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas btab ste/ brtan zhing nus ldan du gyur pa'i mos pa byed cing*/ slob dpon gyi phreng ba nas bzung ste/ tadya thā sogs sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed/ slob dpon la me tog 'dor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi zhes sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis phreng ba sngags dang bcas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi zhes sogs brjod/ gsung gi dngos grub dang rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob/

ngag gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi steng du bhyoḥsmug nag cig bsam/ de nyid la dmigs pa gtad la sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la ci gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag go /de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams bzhugs nas bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgo ba mdzad pa yin pas/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas nas rim par brgyud/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas sogs nas nye bar brgyud de/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rin chen don yod rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub/ 'dren mchog mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ gang bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrubs shig lha mos kyang de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs par mos shing*/ de rnams dngos gzhi rjes gnang gi rim pa'o// mjug tu gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs dang*/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa bstim pa sogs spyi mthun ltar bya/ rjes chog sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o// rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang gi cho ga mdor bsdus rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i phyag len gyi gsung rgyun ma nyams pa bris pa'o//

//maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
